basis: QA-400 (P-485, Lead 20 ruling on #1576, 11 Nov 2026) and QA-415 (P-486, the tech lead, 12 Nov 2026): the sample loader reviews the replayed field-map drafts as the configuration author (api/src/features/checkpoint/040-field-map-review.ts). Where a saved AI answer proposed a library field that is wrong for its form field, the author changes it to the right one on the draft's page (decision CHANGED, the same door a person uses), instead of accepting it. Each row names the proposed key, the key the author decides, and the reason the decision records. Sample review data, not an IRCC rule. A note stays under 300 characters (the decision's limit).

corrections.meaning: Whether the person is the principal applicant, rather than the principal applicant's spouse, common-law partner or dependent child. Worked out for each person from their role on the case; never asked.
corrections.note: QA-400: SCH1 asks this of each person it is about ("*Indicate whether you are": the principal applicant, or their spouse, partner or dependent child 18+). An application fact gave every person the same answer, so it is each person's fact, worked out from their role.

corrections.meaning: The kind of application this person makes (Visitor, Worker, Student, or permanent residence), in the forms' own words. Worked out for each person from their own filing; never asked.
corrections.note: QA-415: IMM 5645 and IMM 5476 name the kind of the application of the person they are about, and a family's members may apply for different documents (a student's spouse for a work permit), so it is each person's fact, from their filing.

boxes_basis: BK-24 (P-533, P-449: data, never a form in code): where a saved AI answer mapped one form field to a fact or a step that is wrong for it, and changing the proposed field itself would change every form field that reads it on that draft, the sample loader corrects that one form field on the applied draft, before any release, as the author would (api/src/features/checkpoint/040-field-map-review.ts: its reason says "Changed by the sample loader", one audit line each). The product has no door yet for a person to remap one mapped form field (follow-up F6 on BK-24): the edition, the form field, the key the saved answer proposed (checked first: a different one is refused in words), the key and step the author decides, and the reason it records. The keys and steps are those IMM 1294 (06-2026) and IMM 5257 (09-2023) already map on the same boxes of the same layout. Sample review data, not an IRCC rule; Unconfirmed: expert.
